designationHistory.indexText: Two Ponds National Wildlife Refuge, a 72-acre urban refuge in Arvada, Colorado, was established in 1992.
designationHistory.note: Only the FWS brochure gives a year ("Established in 1992"). The establishing action and authority were not found, and there is no independent record yet.

sources.name: FWS, Two Ponds NWR general brochure
